### Vocabulary in scope

New at this step:
- weighted carving (also: WeightedCarving) — it is necessary that each weighted carving totals exactly one total weight (HCP L3 — WeightedCarving (parts, weight, mean, total_ne_zero))
- total weight (also: totalWeight) — it is necessary that each total weight is the total weight of exactly one weighted carving (HCP L3 — totalWeight: a piece of the weighted mean; nonzero)
- weighted sum (also: weightedSum) — it is necessary that each weighted sum is the weighted sum of exactly one weighted carving (HCP L3 — weightedSum)
- weighted mean — it is necessary that each weighted mean is the weighted mean of exactly one weighted carving (HCP L3 — WeightedCarving.mean requires nonzero total weight)
- fold — it is necessary that each fold combines exactly one decomposition (HCP L3 — Decomposition.fold: a value per part, combined over a decomposition)
- frame — it is possible that each frame is the frame of at least 1 frame reading (HCP L3 — InFrame: components read in a stated frame)
- frame reading (also: InFrame) — it is necessary that each frame reading is read in exactly one frame (HCP L3 — InFrame)
- union law — it is necessary that each union law aggregates exactly one kind of property (HCP L3 — union_mass, union_centerOfMass, union_inertiaTensor)
- frame-indexed quantity — it is necessary that each frame-indexed quantity is read in exactly one frame (HCP L3 — labOmega, bodyOmega, bodyInertia, rotationalContraction: rigid-body quantities indexed by frame)
- *weighted carving* totals *total weight* — verb
- *total weight* is the total weight of *weighted carving* — verb
- *weighted sum* is the weighted sum of *weighted carving* — verb
- *weighted mean* is the weighted mean of *weighted carving* — verb
- *fold* combines *decomposition* — verb
- *frame reading* is read in *frame* — verb
- *frame* is the frame of *frame reading* — verb
- *union law* aggregates *kind of property* — verb
